primary_sources.title: Harness design for long-running application development
primary_sources.practice: Use the evaluator only where it pays for itself, on tasks beyond what the current model does reliably alone. With a stronger model, one evaluator pass at the end of the run replaced grading after every chunk.
primary_sources.native_mechanism: Claude Code: limit the judged Stop hook, or the evaluator stage in a saved Workflow, to task classes at the model's edge, with deterministic command checks always on. Codex: run `codex review` or an evaluator exec pass only for those task classes.

primary_sources.title: The AI-native SDLC playbook
primary_sources.practice: Run the final completion check as a report-only verifier subagent in a fresh context once the session believes it is done. Keep it separate from the in-task test loop so the verdict is not colored by the assumptions that produced the code.
primary_sources.native_mechanism: Claude Code: a file-based subagent in .claude/agents (the page's verifier.md: tools Bash and Read; runs the app, reports mismatches against plan.md and fixes nothing). It runs before the Stop gate lets the session finish. For Workflow children, a Stop hook goes in the agent frontmatter and runs as SubagentStop.

primary_sources.title: Building a C compiler with a team of parallel Claudes
primary_sources.practice: Because an autonomous agent solves whatever its verifier checks, make the verifier nearly perfect. Add tests for each failure mode you see, and enforce a CI gate so new commits cannot break existing functionality.
